changelog.entry: New achievement, Stored Power: build your first battery storage.
Fixed a display bug where the Achievements/What's New panels showed as empty boxes before their first open and never visually closed again once opened once.

Added a Grid Operator Career (finish a run to bank career points, then spend them on four small permanent perks; achievements now persist across runs), storage arbitrage (charge batteries from surplus, discharge into a shortfall at a peak price), and an opt-in Emergency response starting scenario. Demand response, policy levers, the weather log and auto-maintain schedules are now saved too.
Each plant type now has its own auto-maintain schedule (Manual / every 3 / 5 / 8 rounds), finishing the maintenance-scheduling feature whose backend landed in the previous entry without a UI yet.

Added demand response (a fourth build/retire/maintain-style lever that permanently trims demand growth), a weather-event log narrating how Weather Variability actually affected renewable output round to round, and a periodic policy lever (opt-in carbon pricing or a renewable subsidy, both temporary build-cost shifts).

Added starting scenarios, operator letter grade, grid resilience score, 20-round projection, best-round trend marker, funds bar visuals, clean-streak counter, wear tier glyphs and tooltips, and 'why it happened' disruption toasts.
Retire-button tooltip added: states the 50%-of-current-cost refund rule permanently, not just in a one-time callout.
Shared confirm-dialog integration: retiring a plant type's last unit now asks for confirmation.
Settings panel added: text size (A-/A/A+) and a reduce-motion toggle, both persisted per-browser.
Colorblind-safety audit: fixed a red/green trend-graph line pair (cost line recolored to blue, plus a dash pattern).
Space theme visual pass: starfield background, glass panels, gradient buttons.
Code-quality audits: fixed a retire-refund exploit (refunded off current cost, not flat base cost) and a save/load merge bug.
Pass 3 (fun/teaching balance): added a live disruption-risk message tying rising emissions to brownout chance.
Info Page added with curated real-world sources on energy-sector emissions and renewable cost curves.
Pass 2: global-comparison benchmark line and infrastructure aging/vulnerability.
Pass 1: live emissions/renewable-cost trend graph and a first-unlock context blurb.
All 6 milestones complete: core state loop, emissions + cost curve, disruption events, scoring, feedback prompt, visual pass + hub integration.
